fee_notes: Standard fee $49,000; Conversion franchise $39,000; Veteran/First Responder discount of $10,000 off first unit (so $44,000 standard or $39,000 conversion); multi-pack additional territories $40,000 each; 50% discount available to existing franchisees with 2+ years operating experience meeting expansion requirements. Most recent fiscal year actual fees ranged $5,000-$49,000.
raw_excerpt: You pay us an initial franchise fee of $49,000 when you sign the Franchise Agreement. You must pay an initial franchise fee of $39,000 for a Conversion Franchise. If you purchase additional franchises as part of a multi-pack at the same time that you purchase your first franchise, the fee for each additional franchise is $40,000.
